audit_items.proof_trace: The `FlashLoan` struct has no `has` clause (no drop, store, or copy abilities), and neither does its inner `ReserveFlashLoan`. Move's linear type system enforces at the bytecode-verifier level that non-droppable values must be fully consumed within the same PTB — any transaction that fails to do so is rejected by the VM. The consumption path is complete: `market.repay_flash_loan` destructures `FlashLoan` at L836, and `reserve.repay_flash_loan` destructures `ReserveFlashLoan` at L244, reducing both to primitive `u64` values (which have `drop`).
